messages:
andrea: Heads up — LumenPay (acct LP-472) procurement just told us they require an official PO number before they can accept any invoice. Can we pause invoice generation on our side?

devin: Is this a new requirement or has it been on their T&Cs? Any PO template or required fields?

andrea: New for this quarter — they said legal signed the SOW but purchasing won't process without a Company PO and approver ID. They emailed procurement@lumenpay.com but didn't attach a template.

matt: We can hold the invoice draft, but note usage has already accumulated for Mar. If we hold past billing cutoff we should mark reason to avoid automated dunning. Which invoice ID?

billing-bot: Invoice creation blocked for customer LP-472 due to flag "PO required". Draft created: INV-2026-04-05-LP472. Reminder sent to devin@redwood.com.

olivia: I can mark the invoice as "on hold — awaiting PO" in accounting so collections doesn't trigger. Need the exact PO format (PDF/number) and hold_until date.

devin: I'll ping their procurement contact (Sara). Also need to know whether a pro-forma would ever be accepted as interim — and whether a simple single-line PO is enough. cc @matt

andrea: Message from Sara (procurement): "We require a PO number and cost center. We do accept PDF e-POs, not pro-forma invoices. I can escalate but approver is out until 04/02 — earliest we can issue PO is 04/03."

matt: Thanks. Please set hold on draft and include hold reason text so collections and finance are aligned. Also confirm usage window so invoice lines are correct if PO arrives late.

andrea: Usage window: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31. Target invoice date was 2026-04-05. We'll hold for PO through 2026-04-06 then escalate to AM if missing.

procurement-sr: Hi all — Sara here from LumenPay procurement. Confirming we will send a PDF PO including cost center by 04/03. Apologies for the delay; approver was OOO. No billing address changes.

devin: Thanks Sara. Quick Q: do you need us pre-registered as a vendor (vendor ID) before you accept the PO, or is a PDF with our details sufficient?

procurement-sr: PDF with vendor name + Redwood tax ID is sufficient. If you can include our reference "LP-ENG-2026" in the invoice that's helpful.

matt: Olivia — please apply metadata to draft: hold_reason="Awaiting customer PO (PDF)"; hold_until="2026-04-06"; contact="Sara <procurement@lumenpay.com>"; customer_ref="LP-ENG-2026". Pause dunning.

olivia: Done — draft INV-2026-04-05-LP472 marked on hold, dunning paused, metadata set. Collections notified.

andrea: Great — Devin, please follow up if PO slips past 04/03. If we still don't have it by 04/06 we'll need sales-ops to escalate or consider issuing a pro-forma for internal tracking (but not for collection).

devin: Will do. I'll follow up EOD tomorrow if we haven't received the PO. :white_check_mark:

matt: Thanks team. Logging this as support ticket SUP-8421 for traceability.

andrea: Closing the loop here — I'll update thread when PO is received or if they push the date.
